chat.code_void: Too many wrong codes. Start binding again in Persona to get a new code.
chat.hub_error: Didn't reach Persona: something went wrong on the hub. Send it again in a bit.
chat.not_paired: This robot isn't paired yet. In Persona, open Settings › Channels › DingTalk, bind it, and send the code shown there to this chat.
chat.paired: Paired. What you send here now goes to Persona.
chat.stranger: This robot only works for the person who paired it.
chat.wrong_code: That code is wrong. Check the code shown in Persona.
dingtalk.not_paired: Not paired yet: bind again and send the code to the robot in DingTalk
guide.bind: Enter the app's Client ID and Client Secret here, then send the pairing code to the robot in a one-to-one chat.
guide.create_app: In the DingTalk developer console, create an internal app for your organization.
guide.robot: Add the Robot capability, choose Stream mode for receiving messages, and publish the app.
login.creds_hint: In the DingTalk developer console, create an internal app, add the Robot capability with Stream mode for receiving messages, and publish it. Then enter the app's Client ID and Client Secret.
login.creds_missing: Enter both the Client ID and the Client Secret
login.pair_expired: The pairing code expired. Start binding again
login.pair_hint: In DingTalk, send this code to the robot in a one-to-one chat within 10 minutes. Only the person who sends it can use the robot.
